seq_simple_path.note: seq_simple_path p: p is a nonempty vertex sequence without repeated entries whose consecutive entries are adjacent. The empty sequence is not a path, every one-entry sequence is, a two-entry sequence is one exactly at an edge between distinct vertices; chords are allowed; no endpoint, length or connectedness condition. Equal to nonempty + uniq + sorted (--), to upath x (last x q) q on x :: q, and to the set-to-set path with both sets [set: G].
